Subject: Draft offer for JM (Senior Infra) — candidate deadline 7/11

Hi Rachel / Laura,

Attached is the initial offer (20260709_JM_Offer_v1.pdf) I prepared for Jordan Meyers — Senior Infrastructure Engineer. Candidate just told us they have a competing verbal from CloudWave and asked for our best by EOD Monday 7/11.

Key items in the draft:
- Base: $195,000
- Target bonus: 15%
- Sign-on: $25k (prorated)
- Equity: 0.18% over 4y

Jordan has asked if there's flexibility on base and sign-on. Per the scorecard, strong fit: infra scaling, KV caching, previous infra lead at ScaleByte.

Asking for quick check: can we go to $205k base and $35k sign-on if needed, or should we keep to band? If we need an exception I'll escalate to Vivek.

Thanks — Karthik

Subject: Re: Draft offer for JM (Senior Infra) — candidate deadline 7/11

Karthik / Rachel,

Reviewed comp bands (see CompBands_Q3_2026.xlsx). Senior Infra band (L4) typical range: 170-200k base. $195k is at the top of band. We can approve a one-time sign-on stretch for competitiveness but any base above $200k requires VP approval and a documented business case (HR-1420).

Recommendation: extend the $195k base + $35k sign-on and market-equity refresh at next cycle. If the candidate pushes for $205k base, escalate to Vivek for discretionary exception.

-Neha
HR, Total Rewards
Redwood Inference

Hi Rachel,

Thank you — appreciate the quick turnaround. The role and team sound excellent. Two asks before I can commit:
1) Could you increase base to $205k? CloudWave verbally offered $205k base.
2) Would Redwood consider a $35k sign-on instead of $25k given moving costs and a compensation gap this year.

I can sign immediately if we can meet those numbers. I prefer Redwood but need to be pragmatic on the comp.

Best,
Jordan

Date: 2026-07-11T09:30:00-07:00
Subject: Escalation: candidate counter — JM asking for $205k base + $35k sign-on (deadline EOD)

Team,

Jordan has come back asking for $205k base and $35k sign-on. Per Neha, $205k base is outside band and needs VP approval (HR-1420). We can do $195k + $35k sign-on without further approval. Jordan has said he can sign immediately if we match $205k / $35k and his deadline is EOD 7/11.

Context: Jordan is a top candidate with experience leading large-scale KV cache systems and has multiple B2B infra references. He also expressed preference for Redwood culture and product mission; the competing offer is verbal but firm on numbers.

Options:
- Approve $205k base + $35k sign-on (exception) — will require one-line approval from Vivek and note to finance.
- Hold at $195k + $35k sign-on and risk losing candidate.

Requesting Vivek's quick sign-off by 12:30pm PT so I can respond before candidate deadline.

Thanks — Rachel

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-07-11T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: candidate counter — JM asking for $205k base + $35k sign-on (deadline EOD)

Rachel / team,

Given the impact on our infra roadmap and the scarcity of engineers with Jordan's background, I approve a one-time exception: $205k base + $35k sign-on. Please log the exception ticket (HR-1420) with rationale and get Finance to confirm payroll timing. We should keep equity and bonus terms as-is.

I'll handle the note for leadership. Execute quickly.

— Vivek
